item.title: Lennoxtown Latest - Liam Scales' "Tired" remark tells its own story
item.description: Celtic has just posted a video of the players heading in to training today with only Liam Scales interacting with the chap for the Celtic media team.

item.title: Celtic Manager - Wilfried Nancy Talks Advance with Columbus Crew
item.description: Celtic are closing in on hiring Wilfried Nancy from the Columbus Crew. Here's what his MLS success, tactical style, and background could mean for Celtic's next chapter.

item.title: Nancy - "I think that things are progressing" Martin O'Neill
item.description: "I was speaking to some of the board members last night. Things are progressing very nicely, so I'm hoping that things will be in place by the beginning of next week," Martin O'Neill

item.title: Battle of the Greens - Celtic and rivals wearing green and white hoops
item.description: Celtic are the most famous wearers of green-and-white hoops – but this season, some other clubs have gained publicity for this top too.

item.title: Yang has earned a Celtic start at Easter Road
item.description: It's fair to say that Yang is something of enigma in the eyes of the Celtic support...

item.title: Arne Engels deserves loads of credit and our full respect
item.description: His recent performances have suggested that he's beginning to find the form that persuaded the club to part with a record fee of £11 million for the 22 year old Belgian international midfielder.

item.title: "That’s the dream for all of us again," as Martin O'Neill praises Brendan Rodgers
item.description: Celtic's 3-1 win in Rotterdam has raised spirits at Celtic, from the players to the support who remain divided in their outlook towards the Celtic Board...
